description: This file defines the WKWorkers class responsible for managing WebKit worker sessions, handling worker creation, message dispatching, termination, and console message processing within the Playwright project.

classes.name: WKWorkers
classes.description: Manages WebKit worker sessions, including creation, message handling, and cleanup.

methods.name: setSession
methods.description: Sets up event listeners for worker creation, message dispatch, and termination, initializing worker sessions accordingly.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all worker sessions and associated page workers.

methods.name: initializeSession
methods.description: Enables worker-related features in a given session.

methods.name: _onConsoleMessage
methods.description: Handles console messages from workers, processing and forwarding them to the page.
